Swarna Sub-1 (Swarna*3 x IR 49830  (* parental line(s) from IRRI germplasm)) - rice variety factsheet.
Product profile: Swarna Sub-1 is a late-maturing, medium-height variety with medium slender grains and high yield potential, extensively cultivated in India under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by NRRI and released in 2009, it was specifically recommended for cultivation in the states of Eastern India. It displays remarkable tolerance to complete submergence for up to 15-17 days and is highly adaptable to flood-prone shallow lowlands. With excellent tillering capabilities and low nitrogen responsiveness, it also demonstrates tolerance to low soil phosphorus levels.
Priority market segment: TLaS-R.
Planting method and ecosystem suitability (PTR = puddled transplanted rice, DSR = direct seeded rice): PTR: Recommended; DSR: Not Recommended; Irrigated Lowland: Not Recommended; Rainfed Lowland: Recommended; Upland: Not Recommended.

Swarna Sub-1 - key strengths, considerations and positioning.
Key strengths: Good yield; Medium height; profuse tillering; Submergence tolerance; Late maturity; medium slender grain; High HRR; excellent eating quality; Resistant to leaf blight.
Considerations: Susceptible to leaf blast, sheath blight and false smut; Susceptible to BPH, stem borer and gall midge; Loss of golden hull color as is in Swarna.
Positioning (variety replaced / companion, by ecosystem): Replace - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: Swarna; Upland: None. Companion - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: CR 1009 Sub-1; Upland: None.

Swarna Sub-1 - grain yield, agronomic traits and grain shape (HRR = head rice recovery; grain shape SB = short bold, MS = medium slender, SM = short medium, LB = long bold, MB = medium bold).
Swarna Sub-1 -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 5000-6000; Maturity (days): 140-145; Plant height (cm): 95-105; Lodging: Tolerant; HRR %: 67; 1000-grain wt (g): 20; Grain shape: MS.
Swarna -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 5500-6000; Maturity (days): 140-145; Plant height (cm): 85-90; Lodging: Susceptible; HRR %: 69; 1000-grain wt (g): 16; Grain shape: MS.

Swarna Sub-1 - biotic and abiotic stress reaction (disease and pest tolerance; BPH = brown plant hopper, RTV = rice tungro virus).
Swarna Sub-1 -> Leaf blast: Susceptible; Leaf blight: Resistant; Sheath blight: Susceptible; BPH: Susceptible; Gall midge: Susceptible; Submergence: Tolerant.
Swarna -> Leaf blast: Susceptible; Leaf blight: Resistant; Sheath blight: Susceptible; BPH: Susceptible; Gall midge: Susceptible; Submergence: Susceptible.

Swarna Sub-1 - producibility and recommendation.
Producibility: Swarna Sub-1 = 2000-2200 Kgs./acre.
Recommendation: Released for cultivation in Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal, and Assam. National check in advanced varietal trial (late) conducted by IIRR, India.
